scope: MT management TXD constructor call-site audit
findings: MT beacon helper ap/ap_connect.c:106-134 zeroes MAC_TX_INFO and uses bss_idx/TxSPriv=apidx, PID0.
Legacy RTMP/RLT beacon helper is separate and uses PID_MGMT.
ap/ap_nps.c:87-112 uses a separate TIM packet with PID_MGMT and Q_IDX_BCN. It must not be classified as a beacon merely by queue number.
tx_rx/txs.c:MgmtTxSHandler returns0 without beacon state mutation.
The experimental policy requires management beacon subtype, matching BSS2 and TxSPriv2, and beacon queue. Queue-only suppression would affect the TIM path.
requirements: Keep TIM packet ownership and producer gates in OFF/reopen review
Retain normal DMA-ring owner for TIM and beacon
No blanket PID or host-status disable

dma_observer.finding: Observer walks every occupied beacon-ring cell and decodes own_mac from its current packet TXD. It does not restrict observation to the BeaconPkt pointer. Matching BSS2 therefore includes TIM packets on that ring. Invalid/malformed ownership or cell-count mismatch returns unknown rather than empty.
dma_observer.tim_stop: Prepared RT28xx_UpdateTimToAsic checks bBcnSntReq under BcnRingLock. APMakeBssTimFrame has the shared producer lease; close revokes and joins those producers.
dma_observer.limit: Ring-cell software mapping snapshot; no RF-silence assertion. Packet release remains native DMA completion.
